plugins.name: kowalah
plugins.description: Run an AI operating model programme from Claude. Read your organisation's AI vision map and process coverage, diagnose where cycle time actually goes, redesign processes as-is to to-be, set quality bars on AI-run steps, and raise opportunities with your Kowalah team.

skills.name: kowalah-setup
skills.description: Connect the Kowalah MCP server and work out what the signed-in account can see. Use when the Kowalah plugin has just been installed, when Kowalah tools return nothing or error, when the user asks how to connect Kowalah, or when someone wants to start mapping an AI operating model from scratch.
headings: Then work out which organisation they landed in
They are in a new organisation of their own, and that is fine
They expected their company's organisation and did not get it
They are in their company's organisation
skills.description_zh: 连接Kowalah MCP并确认当前账号可见范围，适用于首次安装、工具无结果或报错，以及从零梳理AI运营模型。

skills.name: process-diagnostic
skills.description: Read one business process honestly — where its cycle time actually goes, how many handoffs it has, and what has never been measured. Use for "walk me through this process", "why does this take so long", "where are the bottlenecks in X", or before proposing any change to a process.
headings: Read the model before you ask
The counting rule that governs everything
Work is measured in minutes. Processes are measured in days.
The rest of the diagnosis block
Use it to challenge, not just to report
skills.description_zh: 如实诊断单个业务流程的周期耗时、交接数量和未测量环节，识别瓶颈，并为提出改动前提供实际依据。

skills.name: process-redesign
skills.description: Take a process from as-is to a proposed to-be — mark up what gets eliminated, merged or kept, then generate the redesign beside the original so the two can be compared. Use for "redesign this process", "how would we do this with AI", "these ten steps should be three", or when a diagnostic shows the process needs restructuring rather than automating.
headings: Read the model before you ask
Why this is not a disposition change
Two things are deliberately cleared on the to-be
Competing options are allowed and usually better
skills.description_zh: 把当前流程转为建议目标流程，标记删除、合并和保留步骤，生成与原流程并排的重设计方案，适用于AI改造或需要重构而非直接自动化的情况。

skills.name: programme-review
skills.description: Review the state of an AI operating model programme — coverage, where constraints concentrate, and whether the work in flight is aimed at the actual gaps. Use for "how is our AI programme going", "where are we with AI", "what should we do next", "prep me for the steering group", or any org-wide or divisional read of AI progress.
headings: Read the model before you ask
The one failure mode this skill exists to prevent
skills.description_zh: 评审组织或部门AI运营模型项目的覆盖、约束集中点及在途工作是否针对真实缺口，支持进展、下一步和指导委员会准备。

skills.name: quality-bar
skills.description: Define what "good" means for a process step and set the checks that hold it there — acceptance criteria, gates and monitors, target scores. Use for "how do we know the AI is doing this right", "set up evals for this step", "what counts as a good output here", or before handing any step to AI.
headings: Read the model before you ask
Jidoka: autonomous steps need a stop-condition
skills.description_zh: 为流程步骤定义合格输出、验收标准、关卡、监控及目标评分，帮助判断AI是否正确执行并在移交步骤给AI前设置评估。

skills.name: raise-opportunity
skills.description: Take an idea or an ask to the Kowalah team properly — check what already exists, test it against the AI vision, score it, and submit it. Use for "I need help with", "raise this with Kowalah", "we should look into", "I've got an idea about", or when a review turns up a gap somebody wants to act on.
headings: Read the model before you ask
2. Get the description to something real
skills.description_zh: 将想法或需求规范提交Kowalah团队，先查既有方案、对照AI愿景并评分，再提出机会，支持评审发现缺口后的推进。

skills.name: spot-opportunities
skills.description: Talk through your own work and find where AI could actually help — grounded in your organisation's AI vision and what already exists, not generic advice. Use for "where could AI help me", "what should I be using AI for", "I'm not sure what to automate", "help me think about my job", or when someone has been told to look for AI opportunities and doesn't know where to start.
headings: Spot opportunities in your own work
Read the model before you ask
Ground it first — this is what stops it being generic AI advice
Then talk about their actual work
skills.description_zh: 围绕个人工作讨论AI的实际帮助机会，依据组织AI愿景和已有方案确定可自动化环节，避免泛化建议。

headings: Two ideas worth knowing before you start
